title: Private platform/storage.yaml (supported)
description: Supported private platform/storage.yaml shape consumed via the data-configuration valueFiles entry. Mirrors rendered StorageClass cloudlab-data (Longhorn, Retain, 2 replicas, ext4) and the ordinary claim budget (2 claims, 4Gi); the chart refuses any deviation. All data retains on removal; deletion needs a previously approved exact-scope policy.
